allergyWarning.title: Important note about allergies and intolerances
allergyWarning.message:
You have entered allergies or intolerances. GustaroAI helps you choose dishes, but it does not replace medical advice or asking the restaurant staff.

Information may be incomplete or incorrect. Please check every dish yourself and do not rely only on the app.

Recommendations can only be shown after you confirm this note.
allergyWarning.logFailedMessage: Please try again. Recommendations will only be shown after the note is confirmed.
